intro: The Wildmane Cleansing Totem is a consecrated ritual implement crafted to purify the northern water well of Mulgore. Entrusted to young defenders of the land, it serves as the final instrument in driving out the toxic corruption left by encroaching goblin ventures.

p: When goblin ventures began poisoning the land and fouling Mulgore's scarce water supplies, the tauren turned to sacred ritual to reverse the blight. After cleansing both the Winterhoof and Thunderhorn water wells, Mull Thunderhorn crafts this final totem to purge the remaining corruption at the Wildmane Water Well north of Thunder Bluff. Infused with natural spirits, the totem cleanses the fetid waters so pure life can nourish the plains once more.
